data.one_liner: Plugin that allows Flutter to communicate with a native WebView.
data.what_it_does: Allows embedding native WebViews into Flutter apps on Android and iOS. Provides a singleton instance to control navigation, execute JavaScript, manage cookies, and listen to webview events.
use_when: You need to display web content inside your mobile Flutter application
You need programmatic control over web navigation, cookies, and JavaScript injection
avoid_when: You need the WebView to integrate seamlessly within the Flutter widget tree without blocking overlapping widgets
You want to use the actively maintained official WebView plugin instead of a deprecated community plugin
strengths: Provides a rich set of APIs for controlling navigation, cookies, and resizing
Supports event streams for URL changes, state changes, and scrolling
weaknesses: The WebView is a native view rendered on top of the Flutter view, preventing overlapping widgets like snackbars or dialogs
The community plugin is deprecated in favor of the official WebView plugin
data.setup_notes: Requires adding NSAppTransportSecurity keys to ios/Runner/Info.plist for iOS.

alternatives.name: webview_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: It is the official and actively maintained WebView plugin supported by the Flutter Team.
